posts.title: A canvas only while something moves
posts.description: Two copies of one card with the same transition. One lives in a canvas all the time. The other is plain HTML, and is moved into a canvas made on the spot for the length of the transition. The page measures what each costs.

posts.title: A notice printed on cloth
posts.description: An article with a link, a button and a checkbox hangs from four pegs as a sheet of cloth. Pull a corner, send a gust through it or scroll the page, and it swings. Its controls can be pressed while it moves, because the hit box follows the triangle under the pointer.

posts.title: Canary crash and stress suite
posts.description: A runner for every past crash, context loss and engine bug recorded in this project, alongside five tap-to-run stress tests that push 2D, WebGL 2, WebGPU, snapshots and DOM lifecycle paths, with one-click Markdown output for Chrome engineers.
